title: New Year Running
statementMd:
New Year is coming in Tree Island! In this island, as the name implies, there are $*n*$ cities connected by $*n* - 1$ roads, and for any two distinct cities there always exists exactly one path between them. For every person in Tree Island, it takes exactly one minute to pass by exactly one road.

There is a weird New Year tradition for runnners in Tree Island, which is called "extreme run". This tradition can be done as follows.

A runner chooses two distinct cities $*a*$ and $*b*$. For simplicity, let's denote the shortest path from city $*a*$ to city $*b*$ as $*p*_{1}, *p*_{2}, ..., *p*_{*l*}$ (here, $*p*_{1} = *a*$ and $*p*_{*l*} = *b*$ holds). Then following happens:

1. The runner starts at city $*a*$.
2. The runner runs from city $*a*$ to $*b*$, following the shortest path from city $*a*$ to city $*b*$.
3. When the runner arrives at city $*b*$, he turns his direction immediately (it takes no time), and runs towards city $*a*$, following the shortest path from city $*b*$ to city $*a*$.
4. When the runner arrives at city $*a*$, he turns his direction immediately (it takes no time), and runs towards city $*b*$, following the shortest path from city $*a*$ to city $*b*$.
5. Repeat step 3 and step 4 forever.

In short, the course of the runner can be denoted as: ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ce96b03d45b3d60488d0709ecd9c452da7d4fed8.png) ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8329962017eca6c5b1488cde265f88781d7903ba.png)

Two runners JH and JY decided to run "extremely" in order to celebrate the New Year. JH has chosen two cities $*u*$ and $*v*$, and JY has chosen two cities $*x*$ and $*y*$. They decided to start running at the same moment, and run until they meet at the same city for the first time. Meeting on a road doesn't matter for them. Before running, they want to know the amount of time they will run.

It is too hard for JH and JY to calculate this, so they ask you for help.

## Input

The first line contains a single positive integer $*n*$ ($5 ≤ *n* ≤ 2 × 10^{5}$) — the number of cities in Tree Island.

Next $*n* - 1$ lines describe the roads of Tree Island. The $*i*$-th line ($1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n* - 1$) of them contains two space-separated integers $*a*_{*i*}$ and $*b*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*} ≤ *n*, *a*_{*i*} ≠ *b*_{*i*}$) — the vertices connected by a single road of the tree.

The next line contains an integer $*t*$ ($1 ≤ *t* ≤ 2 × 10^{5}$) — the number of test cases.

Next $*t*$ lines describes the test cases. The $*j*$-th line ($1 ≤ *j* ≤ *t*$) of them contains four space-separated integers $*u*_{*j*}, *v*_{*j*}, *x*_{*j*}, *y*_{*j*}$ ($1 ≤ *u*_{*j*}, *v*_{*j*}, *x*_{*j*}, *y*_{*j*} ≤ *n*, *u*_{*j*} ≠ *v*_{*j*}, *x*_{*j*} ≠ *y*_{*j*}$). It means that in this test case, JH has chosen two cities $*u*_{*j*}$ and $*v*_{*j*}$, JY has chosen two cities $*x*_{*j*}$ and $*y*_{*j*}$. JH starts running at city $*u*_{*j*}$, and JY starts running at city $*x*_{*j*}$.

## Output

For each test case, print an integer describing the amount of time they should run in minutes. If they have to run for an infinitely long time (in other words, if they never meet at the same city), print -1 instead. If they meet at the beginning of their run, print 0.

## Note

The example looks like:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2ae58e28fb6ccf12c49a7497954a9578369e10c2.png)
statementZhMd:
新年就要来临了！在 Tree Island，正如其名称所示，有 $*n*$ 座城市和 $*n* - 1$ 条道路相连，并且任意两座不同的城市之间都恰好存在一条路径。对于 Tree Island 的每个人来说，通过一条道路恰好需要一分钟。

Tree Island 的跑步者有一个奇怪的新年传统，称为“极限跑”。这一传统的过程如下。

跑步者选择两座不同的城市 $*a*$ 和 $*b*$。为简单起见，我们将从城市 $*a*$ 到城市 $*b*$ 的最短路径记作 $*p*_{1}, *p*_{2}, ..., *p*_{*l*}$（其中满足 $*p*_{1} = *a*$ 且 $*p*_{*l*} = *b*$）。接下来会发生以下事情：

1. 跑步者从城市 $*a*$ 出发。
2. 跑步者沿着从城市 $*a*$ 到城市 $*b*$ 的最短路径，从 $*a*$ 跑向 $*b*$。
3. 当跑步者抵达城市 $*b*$ 时，他立即改变方向（不需要花费时间），沿着从城市 $*b*$ 到城市 $*a*$ 的最短路径跑向 $*a*$。
4. 当跑步者抵达城市 $*a*$ 时，他立即改变方向（不需要花费时间），沿着从城市 $*a*$ 到城市 $*b*$ 的最短路径跑向 $*b*$。
5. 永远重复步骤 3 和步骤 4。

简而言之，跑步者的路线可以表示为：![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ce96b03d45b3d60488d0709ecd9c452da7d4fed8.png) ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8329962017eca6c5b1488cde265f88781d7903ba.png)

两位跑步者 JH 和 JY 决定通过进行“极限跑”来庆祝新年。JH 选择了两座城市 $*u*$ 和 $*v*$，JY 选择了两座城市 $*x*$ 和 $*y*$。他们决定在同一时刻开始跑步，并一直跑到第一次在同一座城市相遇为止。在道路上相遇对他们来说不算相遇。在开始跑步之前，他们想知道自己将要跑多长时间。

JH 和 JY 觉得计算这个问题太困难了，因此向你寻求帮助。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个正整数 $*n*$（$5 ≤ *n* ≤ 2 × 10^{5}$）——Tree Island 中城市的数量。

接下来的 $*n* - 1$ 行描述 Tree Island 的道路。第 $*i*$ 行（$1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n* - 1$）包含两个用空格分隔的整数 $*a*_{*i*}$ 和 $*b*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$，$*a*_{*i*} ≠ *b*_{*i*}$），表示由一条道路直接连接的两个顶点。

下一行包含一个整数 $*t*$（$1 ≤ *t* ≤ 2 × 10^{5}$）——测试用例的数量。

接下来的 $*t*$ 行描述各个测试用例。第 $*j*$ 行（$1 ≤ *j* ≤ *t*$）包含四个用空格分隔的整数 $*u*_{*j*}, *v*_{*j*}, *x*_{*j*}, *y*_{*j*}$（$1 ≤ *u*_{*j*}, *v*_{*j*}, *x*_{*j*}, *y*_{*j*} ≤ *n*$，$*u*_{*j*} ≠ *v*_{*j*}$，$*x*_{*j*} ≠ *y*_{*j*}$）。这表示在该测试用例中，JH 选择了城市 $*u*_{*j*}$ 和 $*v*_{*j*}$，JY 选择了城市 $*x*_{*j*}$ 和 $*y*_{*j*}$。JH 从城市 $*u*_{*j*}$ 开始跑步，JY 从城市 $*x*_{*j*}$ 开始跑步。

## 输出格式

对于每个测试用例，输出一个整数，表示他们需要跑步的时间（分钟）。如果他们需要无限长时间跑步（换句话说，如果他们永远不会在同一座城市相遇），则输出 -1。如果他们在跑步开始时就相遇，则输出 0。
